title: Nothintsila, Ngqeleni (map point approximate): police shoot dead three suspected extortionists, 2 Nov
summary: Three men police described as suspected extortionists were shot dead in a confrontation with Mthatha Tactical Response Team members on the Nothintsila gravel road, Ngqeleni, at about 10:15 on Monday 2 November, Eastern C...
story: Three men police described as suspected extortionists were shot dead in a confrontation with Mthatha Tactical Response Team members on the Nothintsila gravel road, Ngqeleni, at about 10:15 on Monday 2 November, Eastern Cape police spokesperson Brig Nobuntu Gantana said. Police say the officers approached the three men after a tip-off that they were collecting money from local shops, and that the men opened fire; no officers were injured. Three pistols with filed-off serial numbers were recovered. The men had not been identified. IPID was called to investigate the deaths. The map point is approximate: the Ngqeleni town point, not the scene.
incident: Mon 2 Nov 2026, about 10:15 (police, via IOL and Daily Dispatch)
location_note: APPROXIMATE MAP POINT. Nothintsila gravel road, Ngqeleni (Nyandeni). Nothintsila is not in Nominatim, so the pin is the Ngqeleni town point (-31.6731, 29.0351). Area level, about 10 km.
